exposure: Surface rendering of early gestation magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans
Surface modeling of early gestation MRI scans
Medical illustration combined with diagnostic imaging data
outcome: Enhanced accuracy of early visualization of conjoined twins
Enhanced clinical value of early visualization of conjoined twins
Parental visualization of likely presentation at birth
Assistance for multidisciplinary team in planning postnatal management
cohort: The study included four sets of conjoined twins who were diagnosed before 17 weeks gestation.
finding: Combining surface rendering and modeling of early gestation diagnostic imaging with medical illustration creates realistic and informative images of conjoined twins, aiding parental understanding and multidisciplinary perinatal planning.
